text:
viv: Quick idea  let's run a one-week "Bench & Build Blitz" for OSS devs: 3 short tutorials, one showcase refapp, and a mentor workshop. Need launch post, benchmark narrative, tutorial cadence, refapp repo, webinar funnel, inbound routing.

sam: love that name. can we frame the benchmark narrative as "real dev workload" rather than synthetic tests? short reproducible script + 2x numbers (latency/cost).

ren: yep. i'll author the mini-benchmark (bench.sh) and a 2-sentence blurb for the post. ETA Wed.

jo: i'll own the refapp repo: minimal demo app, MIT, CONTRIBUTING.md for mentors, and a one-command quickstart. ETA Tue.

pat: i'll handle the webinar funnel + emails. propose gated form, UTMs, HubSpot tags "blitz_interest", and an auto-invite to #bench-build-blitz Slack channel.

viv: webinar format: 35m build + 20m live Q&A + open mentor benches after. want mentor volunteers? find 2 from community.

sam: i can reach out to @mira and @frank. also we should add a short slide that highlights the benchmark results mid-demo. makes the launch post credible.

ren: metrics to track: landing CTR, signups, webinar RSVP->attend conversion, tutorial completions, repo stars, routed MQLs. will push a small CSV of bench runs and a 3-line summary.

jo: content tree i'll add to repo:
```
/tutorials/blitz/lab-1-quickstart.md
/tutorials/blitz/lab-2-batching-cache.md
/tutorials/blitz/lab-3-deploy-lite.md
/refapps/blitz-showcase/README.md
/benchmarks/blitz-demo-blurb.md
```

pat: email drip plan: confirm (immediate), 24h reminder, 1d follow-up w/ repo + replay + next labs. also add a HubSpot workflow: +10 points for attend, +15 for lab completion.

sam: launch post angle ideas: "Build a tiny refapp and see real latency & cost for dev workloads"  callout: include bench snippet and a small screenshot of the perf graph.

viv: ops checklist: ensure demo prompt is stable, include fallback model variant for the live demo, and pin refapp to v0.1 before publish.

marketing-bot: task created /tasks/9012 assigned to @viv @pat @ren. review due Wed 09:00 PT.

jo: ETA recap: repo Tue (v0.1), bench Wed, tutorials Thu, post review Wed, publish next Thu, webinar 10 days after publish. sync Tue 09:30 PT.

viv: TL;DR: bench + refapp + short tutorials this week, landing & emails by Thu, publish next Thu, run workshop 10 days later. :rocket:
